To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the hybridization of a particle swarm optimization with an adjoint of a krigization objective function leads to a reduction in the cost of the krigization process.
the hybridized PSO algorithm outperforms other methods in terms of the number of likelihood evaluations required.
the hybridized particle swarm is a very promising approach to tuning kriging models.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an algorithm which aims to efficiently tune a kriging surrogate model for the purpose of optimization.
the development and implementation of a hybridized tuning strategy for kriging.
the construction of an efficient surrogate model for the optimization of high fidelity simulations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the hybridized particle swarm is the best performing strategy in all but the most computationally intensive of the test cases.
this hybridized tuning strategy performs well, but is not necessarily superior to the other strategies tested.
the hybridized strategy out performs all others with respect to the airfoil inverse design, and is comparable to the best other strategies with respect the airfoil design for minimum drag.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the proposed hybridized strategy is a promising method for the construction of kriging models, however, it is not yet a replacement for the traditional optimization of the multi model likelihood function.
the hybridized particle swarm is the most efficient method for the construction of the surrogate model.
the hybridized particle swarm strategy outperforms other strategies with respect both to the cost of the tuning and the quality of the resulting kriging model.
The main takeaway from our work is that
hybridization of a surrogate model construction method can significantly improve the efficiency of a design or optimization process.
the adjoint based strategy is able to reduce the cost associated with the likelihood function optimization by a factor of 10 to 1000.
the hybridized particle swarm is the most efficient strategy when tuning the hyperparameters of a krigization model.
